title: The Customer Bought Less. Rewrite the Plan.
excerpt: A smaller renewal changes the commercial record. Check which customer work still matters, what can be delivered and which promises need a new decision.
primary_goal: Choose which customer workflows to keep, narrow or pause after a smaller renewal without inventing a change in entitlement.
primary_cta: Use the Downsell Plan Reset on one smaller renewal whose success plan still describes the old relationship.
playbook_description: A one-page decision record for updating the working plan after a smaller renewal.

subject_variants.label: primary
subject_variants.subject: Your customer bought less. What changed in the plan?
subject_variants.preheader: Keep, narrow or pause the work, with the customer owner and service commitments clear.
